indicator.name: Equity Risk Premium (NASDAQ-100 proxy)
indicator.description: The NASDAQ-100 trailing earnings yield minus the 10-year Treasury yield.
indicator.source_name: NASDAQ-100 trailing P/E (daily snapshots) + U.S. Treasury 10-year yield
indicator.methodology: Trailing earnings yield (100 / the NASDAQ-100 trailing P/E, read daily from Yahoo Finance's QQQ figure) minus the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield. Both legs are nominal. The P/E is never forward-looking and never taken from the S&P 500.
indicator.limitations: No free source publishes NASDAQ-100 earnings history, so this series starts on the first day the snapshot job ran and grows by one observation per trading day. Its score is withheld until the history is long enough for a meaningful percentile. ETF-reported P/Es are approximate and are not revised.
